rule: Do not regenerate or treat host XML as authoritative until the firmware source dialect is recovered and reviewed.

known_non_authoritative_consumer_source.evidence: Host XML uses low message IDs (e.g. READ_PARAM=9, PmsmConfig=10), while current firmware generated headers use AppOpMode=30056 and AppMotionParam=30059.

recovery_acceptance: Recover or reconstruct the exact firmware source XML/dialect input.
Re-generate headers reproducibly and match existing message IDs, field order/types, lengths and CRCs.
Pin the generator version and source dialect blob.
Only then add per-product MAVLink bindings to the Product Contract.
